Claim command: omo-gateway lane claim-done qa-1 --evidence "<evidence>"

Lane done protocol
When every Done signal is live and every change is pushed, run the claim command from your own session. For local or QA-only work the signals can be a command, file or URL. Run them yourself first: the watcher re-runs every signal and never takes your word for it. The lane key above is required.
After claiming, stay idle and start no new work. The lead receives a done_claimed event. A claim starts a five-minute objection window. Before closing, the watcher reads every signal live and refuses uncommitted tracked changes or commits on no remote. Closing marks the thread done and removes lane-owned worktrees.
If the lead objects or a check fails, you receive [LEAD] not done: <reasons>; keep working, claim again when fixed. Fix every reason, then claim again for a fresh five-minute window.
